RESPONDENT CASUCCIO ADMITTED THAT HE IN FACT HAD TOLD HIS CLIENTS THAT THE MONEY WOULD BE INVESTED, BUT STATED THAT THE MONEY WAS INSTEAD DIVERTED FOR HIS PERSONAL USE. RESPONDENT CASUCCIO SOLICITED WEST VIRGINIA RESIDENTS TO INVEST THROUGH HIS UNINCORPORATED BUSINESS, SUMMIT TRADING, PROMISING RETURNS TO INVESTORS THROUGH A \"LOAN AGREEMENT\" SIGNED BY THE INVESTORS AND RESPONDENT CASUCCIO. THE SECURITIES BEING OFFERED AND SOLD IN THE STATE OF WEST VIRGINIA BY RESPONDENT CASUCCIO ARE NOT REGISTERED OR EXEMPT FROM REGISTRATION IN THE STATE OF WEST VIRGINIA. THE OFFER AND SALE OF UNREGISTERED NON-EXEMPT SECURITIES IN THE STATE OF WEST VIRGINIA IS A VIOLATION OF WEST VIRGINIA CODE \u00a732-3-301.
